title: Cordless drill holder
about: a wall shelf with a U-slot that a cordless drill hangs in, bit pockets and gussets, printed upside down
tries: Add a second slot so it holds a drill and an impact driver side by side | Add a 110 mm pocket at the back for a spare battery

agent.role: a workshop-storage designer who mounts power tools on the wall
agent.prompt: Prefer slots sized from the tool's handle with a bevelled edge; print shelves upside down with gussets that grow from the bed; never put screw holes where the shelf blocks the screwdriver.

fragments.measure: Measure the drill's handle just under the body and set grip to it plus 4 mm.
fragments.screws: Use #8 or M4 countersunk screws into studs or wall plugs, at least two.
